definition: A CID this repo calls, served elsewhere. Entries are not seams of this repo; the producer is somebody else's services scope.

depends_on.because: Measured 2026-09-07 against the live seam. GET /_cpcp/cid.json publishes exactly build.list, build.get and build.create. POST /_cpcp/rpc with method contextframe.list answers HTTP 200 and {"ok":false,"error":{"reason":"unknown_operation","because":"no CPCP operation \"contextframe.list\""}}. magentic-stack GAP107 records the ContextFrame/Meaning/Clarification frame as SHACL shapes and explicitly not a CPCP operation yet.
depends_on.shape_source: magentic-stack gems/shapes-level-8/bundles/contextframe.shacl.ttl -- containment: a Meaning sits under a ContextFrame, a Clarification under a Meaning
depends_on.expects: A collection of ContextFrame, each with a canonicalId and title, Meanings nested under it and Clarifications nested under those. The client reads cf: prefixed and bare property names, and refuses a frame without a canonicalId rather than synthesising one.
depends_on.on_refusal: Falls back to data/contextframes.local.json and labels it local -- in the API response, in a banner, and in the footer of every generated prompt. Nothing local is ever presented as upstream.
depends_on.verified_by: tests/contextframes.test.js -- one test stands up a seam that DOES publish contextframe.list and asserts provenance flips to upstream, so the day this status becomes published is a data change here, not a code change.

note: The CID is read before the method is called, so this repo knows what the seam offers rather than inferring it from a failed call. That is what lets 'status' be a measurement rather than a guess.
invariants: A frame served from the local file is never labelled as served by the producer.
This repo calls no other seam, and holds no credential for this one: the operations it depends on are unauthenticated reads.
